players.bio: Aaron William Cresswell (born 15 December 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Cresswell made his first-team debut for Tranmere Rovers in 2008 and made 70 league appearances for the club before signing for Ipswich Town in 2011, following a tribunal to agree the value of the transfer.

Benjamin James Gibson (born 15 January 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Having graduated from Middlesbrough's Academy, Gibson had loan spells with Plymouth Argyle, York City and Tranmere Rovers before breaking into the club's first team in 2013.
Benjamin Anthony Johnson (born 24 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a full back for EFL Championship club Stoke City, on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town.

Benjamin David Pearson (born 4 January 1995) is an English professional footballer at EFL Championship club Stoke City. Pearson began his career at Manchester United's academy. He spent time out on loan at Barnsley, before signing for Preston North End in January 2016. Pearson spent five years at Deepdale before joining AFC Bournemouth in January 2021.

Benjamin Lewis Wilmot (born 4 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Wilmot began playing football in the academies at Hitchin Town and Stevenage, breaking into Stevenage's first team during the 2017–18 season. He signed for Watford in May 2018 and was loaned to Serie A club Udinese in January 2019.

Mohammed Bosun Lawal (born 30 May 2003) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender and midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the Republic of Ireland national team. Born in Dublin, he began his career with Corduff FC, St. Kevin's Boys and Bohemians before joining Watford's academy and later Celtic.
El Hadji Djibril Soumaré (born 7 January 2003) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City.
Eric-Junior Doriane Magate Kom Baga Bocat (born 16 July 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a left-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City.

Ethan Stuart William Galbraith (born 11 May 2001) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the Northern Ireland national team. Galbraith left Linfield to join the Manchester United academy in 2017. He made his first-team debut for United in a UEFA Europa League match against Astana in November 2019.

Francis David Fielding (born 4 April 1988) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Stoke City. He began his career at Blackburn Rovers in the Premier League. He spent time on loan at Wycombe Wanderers, Northampton Town, Rochdale, Leeds United, and Derby County, before making a permanent move to Derby County.

George David Eric Hirst (born 15 February 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Born in England, he plays for the Scotland national team. Hirst began his career with hometown club Sheffield Wednesday before a contract dispute saw him join Leicester City via OH Leuven in 2019.
Jack Ryan McGlynn (born July 7, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the United States national team.

Jonathan Ronald Walters (born 20 September 1983) is a former professional footballer who played as a forward. He is sporting director of Stoke City. Walters started his senior career at Blackburn Rovers but failed to break into the first team and joined Bolton Wanderers. He then went out on loan to Hull City, Crewe Alexandra and Barnsley before joining Hull permanently.
Joshua James Griffiths (born 5 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Stoke City.

Bae Jun-ho (Korean: 배준호; born 21 August 2003) is a South Korean professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the South Korea national team. Bae began his professional career with Daejeon Hana Citizen, helping them gain promotion to K League 1 in the 2022 season.

Junior Baptiste Tchamadeu (born 22 December 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Born in England, he plays for the Cameroon national team.

Justin Devenny (born 11 October 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder, attacking midfielder or wing-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Born in Scotland, he plays for the Northern Ireland national team.
Mohammed Lamine Cissé (born 15 February 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Stoke City.
Luca Dylan Bombino (born July 10, 2006) is an American professional soccer player who plays left-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City.
Luke Robin Graham (born 11 February 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship side Stoke City and the Scotland national team.

Maksym Vadymovych Talovierov (Ukrainian: Максим Вадимович Таловєров; born 28 June 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Born in Russia, he plays for the Ukraine national team.

Mark Gordon Robins (born 22 December 1969) is an English football manager and former player who is the manager of EFL Championship club Stoke City. As a player, he was a striker and is best known for his time in the Premier League with Manchester United, Norwich City and Leicester City. Robins began his career with Manchester United.
Million Eljoenai Levinio Manhoef (born 3 January 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Stoke City.

Róbert Boženík (born 18 November 1999) is a Slovak professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Stoke City and the Slovakia national team. Boženík began his career with Žilina, scoring 15 goals in 2018–19 which saw him join Dutch Eredivisie club Feyenoord in January 2020.

Samuel James Gallagher (born 15 September 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Originally a member of the Plymouth Argyle youth academy, Gallagher joined Southampton in 2012 and earned a call-up to the first team at the beginning of the 2013–14 season.
Svante Ulf Ingel Ingelsson (born 14 June 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City.

Tomáš Rigo (born 3 July 2002) is a Slovak professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Stoke City. Rigo began his career with Czech side Slavia Prague progressing through their youth academy to make his professional debut in December 2020. He spent two seasons on loan in the Czech National Football League with Vlašim before joining Baník Ostrava in June 2023.

Tobias Viktor Johansson (born 14 September 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Stoke City, which he captains, and the Sweden national team. A product of the Hammarby and Aston Villa academies, Johansson spent two years at Premier League side Leicester City but only appeared in EFL Trophy matches for their U21 side.
